highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148 and rolling up all 4.147.x preview work.
highlights_body: This release delivers variable fonts, animated WebP, color font palettes, and a new singleton lifecycle model, alongside the Skia m132–m148 engine jump. It is a breaking release — see the changes below before upgrading from 3.x.

breaking.title: SKPaint and SKFont text/font APIs promoted to compile errors
breaking.body: The legacy text/font members on SKPaint that were [Obsolete] warnings in 3.x are now compile errors. Move typeface, text size, and related state onto SKFont. The `SKPaint.Typeface`, `SKPaint.TextSize`, `SKPaint.TextScaleX`, and related members that were already obsoleted are now errors.

breaking.title: new SKFont() now has an empty typeface
breaking.body: Upstream m132 removed lazy default-typeface resolution. `new SKFont().Typeface` is now `SKTypeface.Empty` (0 glyphs) rather than resolving to the platform default at draw time — `MeasureText` returns 0 and nothing is drawn. Fix: construct with `new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default)`. Detect unset via `font.Typeface.IsEmpty` instead of `== null`.

breaking.title: new SKPaint().Typeface returns SKTypeface.Default instead of null
breaking.body: The null-typeface lazy-default semantics changed. `new SKPaint().Typeface` is now `SKTypeface.Default` (non-null). Text drawing still works; the only observable break is code checking `paint.Typeface == null` to detect 'no typeface set' — use `paint.Typeface.IsEmpty` or drop the check.

breaking.title: SKTypeface.FromFamilyName returns Default (not null) on Android for missing families
breaking.body: All platforms now return `SKTypeface.Default` when a family name is not found. Previously Android returned `null`. For strict null-on-miss semantics use `SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name, style)` which still returns null on no match.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move(long) is obsolete and throws OverflowException for out-of-range offsets
breaking.body: The native offset is 32-bit. The `Move(long)` overload previously truncated silently; it now uses a checked cast and throws `OverflowException` for out-of-range values. Call `Move(int)` (validate/clamp large values first). The `long` overload is marked `[Obsolete]`.

breaking.title: GRContext.CreateVulkan terminates the process on Vulkan < 1.1
breaking.body: Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1. On a 1.0 instance or device Skia calls SK_ABORT and the process terminates — this is not catchable. Declare `VK_API_VERSION_1_1` in your `VkApplicationInfo.apiVersion` and in `GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion`. Hardware that supports only 1.0 must use raster or another backend.

breaking.title: GRVkBackendContextNative: five interop fields removed
breaking.body: The fields `fMinAPIVersion`, `fInstanceVersion`, `fExtensions`, `fFeatures`, and `fOwnsInstanceAndDevice` are removed from the interop struct. Use `fVkExtensions` in place of `fExtensions`, `fDeviceFeatures`/`fDeviceFeatures2` in place of `fFeatures`, and delete the ownership/version fields.

breaking.title: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo retype and GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo loses value equality
breaking.body: The property type changed from `GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo` to `GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo`. The old type no longer implements `IEquatable<T>` or equality operators. Update field assignments and any equality comparisons.

breaking.title: SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose setter removed
breaking.body: The protected setter was removed. Subclasses that assigned this property must be updated; the value is now set only in the constructor.

bullets.lead: Skia updated to milestone m148 (from m131/m132)
bullets.detail: The engine makes a major jump through Skia milestones m132, m133, m147, and finally m148, delivering years of upstream rendering improvements, GPU optimisations, and correctness fixes.
Two upstream syncs from the chrome/m147 branch apply engine stability and rendering correctness improvements to the release line.

bullets.lead: Variable font support in SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp
bullets.detail: Variable fonts can now be created and manipulated via axis settings. HarfBuzzSharp gains matching variable-font shaping APIs.

bullets.lead: Color font palette support and improved variable font robustness
bullets.detail: New APIs expose color font palettes, allowing selection and customisation of emoji and icon font rendering. Variable font enumeration is also made more robust.
SkiaSharp can now encode animated WebP files. SKWebpEncoder gains a new API for writing multi-frame animated WebP.
A new SKStream.GetData() method returns the stream's contents as an SKData without an intermediate copy when the underlying stream supports it.

bullets.lead: SKSamplingOptions support on SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas
bullets.detail: Draw calls on SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas now accept SKSamplingOptions, giving callers control over image resampling quality.
A new HBColor struct wraps the HarfBuzz hb_color_t RGBA color type, and missing API wrappers for color palette queries are added.
The singleton instance lifecycle is reworked to be more robust and predictable, fixing subtle re-entry and double-dispose problems.

bullets.lead: SKPixmap/SKBitmap GetPixelSpan stride and offset fixed
bullets.detail: GetPixelSpan was using pixel-width instead of RowBytes for stride calculation, and GetPixelSpan<T>(x,y) was using Height instead of Width for the x-axis offset. Both are now correct.

bullets.lead: SKPath finalizer crash fixed when SKPathBuilder is collected first
bullets.detail: If the GC collected SKPathBuilder before SKPath in a finalizer ordering edge case, SKPath's finalizer crashed. SKPath now roots its builder correctly.

bullets.lead: WinUI Projection DLL not found on .NET 9 fixed
bullets.detail: The WinUI projection assembly was not resolved correctly in .NET 9 consumer projects.

bullets.lead: Android SKGLView not rendering after tab switch in MAUI fixed
bullets.detail: SKGLView on Android stopped rendering after the host tab was switched away and back in a MAUI app. The GL context is now restored correctly.

bullets.lead: Default typeface resolution on Android API 36+ fixed
bullets.detail: The font manager on Android API 36 could return null for the default typeface, causing a crash. SkiaSharp now falls back to SKTypeface.Empty rather than crashing.

bullets.lead: Linux Bionic (Android NDK system image) native assets added
bullets.detail: SkiaSharp now ships native assets for Linux Bionic, enabling use in Android NDK applications and Bionic-based system images.

bullets.lead: Tizen x64 and arm64 native build support added
bullets.detail: Native builds for Tizen now cover x64 and arm64 architectures.

bullets.lead: Apple platform TFMs: 26.0 library TFMs and unversioned app TFMs
bullets.detail: Native library targets use the versioned 26.0 Apple TFM, and app targets use the unversioned forms, aligning with Apple's current SDK conventions.

bullets.lead: WASM pre-.NET 8 Emscripten native builds dropped
bullets.detail: Native WASM builds for Emscripten versions targeting pre-.NET 8 runtimes are no longer produced, reducing package size.
Bundled native libraries updated: expat 2.8.1, HarfBuzz 14.2.0, libjpeg-turbo 3.1.4.1, FreeType 2.14.3, zlib 1.3.2.1-motley, libpng 1.6.58, libexpat 2.7.5.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Drove the entire v4 preview cycle: Skia milestone bumps (m132, m147), variable and color font APIs, singleton lifecycle rework, SKPaint obsolete promotion, WASM improvements, and the SKPath finalizer fix.
contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Contributed Linux Bionic native asset support and PolySharp C# 13 compatibility for legacy TFMs.
contributor_summaries.ebariche: Contributed fixes and improvements during the v4 preview cycle.
contributor_summaries.sasakrsmanovic: Contributed improvements during the v4 preview cycle.
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Fixed SKGLView not rendering after a tab switch in MAUI on Android.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0 adds variable font shaping support, new HBColor struct and color palette query APIs, and updates the underlying HarfBuzz library to 14.2.0.

preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Opened the v4 line with the Skia m147 engine update.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Delivered animated WebP encoding, SKStream.GetData, and SKPath finalizer fix.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Added libjpeg-turbo and WASM pre-.NET 8 cleanup; further m147 stability work.
preview_summaries.v4.148.0-rc.1.2: Landed the Skia m148 update, GetPixelSpan fixes, singleton lifecycle rework, and final breaking-change promotions.
